summary.text: Soul Taker Battlefield is a battlefield killer move He Feng Yang names when two mysterious Gu Immortals trap him in fog.

claims.text: Within the thick fog, dark blue soul beasts form until they match He Feng Yang’s crane group. He Feng Yang asks if this is soul taker battlefield. The two mysterious Gu Immortals laugh and call him knowledgeable. The move has a vile reputation and is hard to deal with. Living beings who die in this battlefield have their souls taken and transformed into soul beasts under the user’s control. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable created it when he was young. He Feng Yang wonders who these two are, that they have a battlefield killer move, soul taker, long lost in history.

Soul beasts fight the crane groups. Shredded soul beast fragments can form into new soul beasts here. When a flying crane dies, the battlefield takes its soul and forms a soul beast for the enemy. The two mysterious Gu Immortals say they showed weakness on purpose to delay until the soul taker battlefield had grown, and that He Feng Yang’s enslavement path advantage is gone. They then use tornado dragon whip and killer bee stab, and large numbers of crane souls feed new soul beasts.

The battlefield is filled with fog, easy to lose one’s direction, and hard to escape. He Feng Yang uses expand space Immortal Gu. Yellow light breaks a hole, and the nine palace crane carries him out.
The other two mysterious Gu Immortals cancel soul taker battlefield and leave because it cannot trap him.

At Luo Po Valley, Feng Jiu Ge takes Qin Bai Sheng’s battlefield for soul taker battlefield. He says this move is outdated: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable made it when young, it only converts the souls of living beings into soul beasts, and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable used it to create fighting soul battlefield, which can produce endless soul beasts. Feng Jiu Ge then sees it is not soul taker battlefield.

Wu Shuai sees a soul path battlefield killer move. Black clouds spread. Dragon Palace and Qi Sea Ancestor retreat. Immortal killer move Soul Taker Battlefield is named. Spectral Soul had used this famous battlefield killer move to kill countless enemies. If Dragon Palace were trapped by it, the chance of escaping would be close to zero. Fang Yuan had Shadow Sect’s true inheritance, which included this move. Spectral Soul used the split move technique to split it into many parts. The first part is black smoke, which he can sustain and move.
